info.title: Cairn API
info.description:
Cairn walks a family through the logistics of a death, one step at a time.

Every response that moves a conversation forward carries a `next_step` with a
single prompt, so clients can ask one question at a time. Errors use RFC 9457
problem details (`application/problem+json`) and never echo submitted values.

Authentication is an Auth0 access token. Accounts can be created with Google,
Apple, or an email magic link (see GET /v1/welcome). Onboarding follows
UC-REG-01 to UC-REG-14, one question per screen. The free trial is 28 days from
the first case, after which the account is read-only until subscribed. The
case is the security boundary and is enforced in the database with
row-level security.

get.description: UC-REG-01. Acknowledgment first, then three equally weighted ways to continue, a sign-in link, and a link to the public journey map. Asks for nothing. After a cancelled Google or Apple sign-in, call with oauth_cancelled=true to add the reassurance note (UC-REG-02, UC-REG-03).

get.summary: Ways to create an account or sign in
get.description: Google, Apple, or email (a passwordless magic link by default). Each option names the Auth0 connection the client passes to Auth0's /authorize endpoint. No sign-in is needed to call this.

post.summary: Create the account, or sign in and resume onboarding
post.description: UC-REG-02 to UC-REG-05 and UC-REG-13. Call after every Auth0 sign-in. Auth0 has already verified the Google or Apple identity token, or the email magic link, and this API verifies Auth0's signed token. Email and sign-in method come from the token, never from the body. A new account starts in pending_onboarding and the response is the Privacy Policy and Terms acknowledgment. There is no age question. A returning user gets 200 and the first incomplete step, with a welcome-back note.

200.description: Account already existed. Resumes at the first incomplete step.

403.description: Email not yet confirmed, or an unsupported sign-in method.

409.description: This email already has an account created another way (UC-REG-05). sign_in_method names it and next_step offers it as the primary button.

get.summary: Where the user is in onboarding
get.description: UC-REG-13. Returns the first incomplete step, or a changed acknowledgment to re-read.

post.summary: Agree to, or say "I'm not sure" about, an acknowledgment
post.description: UC-REG-07 (privacy_terms), UC-REG-08 (trial_terms), UC-REG-09 (ai_notice), and UC-REG-10. Agreeing requires the document_version shown with the checkbox and appends a consent record with the version, time, sign-in method, and client. agreed=false records nothing and offers ways forward. Also used to re-acknowledge a changed version (UC-REG-13). The trial clock does not start here.

409.description: An earlier step isn't finished yet. next_step says which one.

422.description: document_version isn't the current one. Show the screen again.

put.summary: Save what Cairn should call the user
put.description: UC-REG-11. A name pre-filled from Google or Apple is only saved when the user sends it here. Legal names are not collected. If the text shows signs of distress, nothing is saved and sign-up pauses (UC-REG-14).

409.description: An earlier step isn't finished yet. next_step says which one.

put.summary: Choose how Cairn talks with the user
put.description: UC-REG-12. Saves the chosen voice on the account. choose_for_me selects the default voice. The voice changes tone only, never the crisis protocol, AI disclosure, attorney referrals, or citations. Finishes onboarding (status active_no_case) and hands off to case creation with a confirmation in the chosen voice.

409.description: An earlier step isn't finished yet. next_step says which one.

get.description: UC-REG-14. Stops the task flow. Returns an acknowledgment and the 988 resource, and nothing else. Nothing is stored, no timers or reminders are set, and progress already saved stays saved. No sign-in needed, so it works from the welcome screen too. The same for every voice.

post.description: After UC-REG-12. The relationship shapes the wording of case creation. A power of attorney is told that authority generally ends at death. Not stored here. It's saved on the case when the case is created.

409.description: Onboarding isn't finished, or an acknowledgment changed.

get.description: Includes the effective status (read_only after the trial), the trial end date in the account's time zone, the AI guide label, and any banner or reminder to show.

patch.description: Preferred name, pronunciation, voice, and time zone. The voice changes tone only. It never changes the crisis protocol, AI disclosure, referrals, or citations.

get.description: UC-ACCT-01 steps 1 and 2. Explain plainly, then ask for confirmation.

post.summary: Delete the account and personal data
post.description: UC-ACCT-01. Deletes the account, its consents and reminders, and every case it created, now, in one transaction. This is deletion, not deactivation. The Auth0 user is deleted, and Apple tokens are revoked through the Sign in with Apple REST API, by a job that works through the queue this adds to. Works in every status, including read-only.

post.summary: Start a case and record who died
post.description: UC-5. Creates the case, the caller's owner membership, and the deceased record in one transaction. The account's first case also starts the 28-day free trial in that transaction (UC-REG-08), and the response carries a note with the local end date. Needs finished onboarding and a writable account. UC-8: a fiduciary can include death_event and estate_flags in the same request, and set start_journey to build the journey once the minimum fields are present.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, the case does not exist, or the account is read-only (code account_read_only).

409.description: Onboarding isn't finished, or a changed acknowledgment needs to be agreed to.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, the case does not exist, or the account is read-only (code account_read_only).

409.description: Onboarding isn't finished, or a changed acknowledgment needs to be agreed to.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, the case does not exist, or the account is read-only (code account_read_only).

409.description: Onboarding isn't finished, or a changed acknowledgment needs to be agreed to.

put.description: UC-6. Replaces all death-event fields. Omitted optional fields are cleared.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, the case does not exist, or the account is read-only (code account_read_only).

409.description: Onboarding isn't finished, or a changed acknowledgment needs to be agreed to.

patch.summary: Answer the veteran and will questions
patch.description: UC-7. Send one answer at a time. Omitted answers are unchanged. 'skip' saves 'unknown'.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, the case does not exist, or the account is read-only (code account_read_only).

409.description: Onboarding isn't finished, or a changed acknowledgment needs to be agreed to.

post.description: UC-9. Matches the deceased's details to the current task templates and creates the case's tasks. Returns 409 with the missing fields until the date and state of death are recorded. Safe to repeat.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the case does not exist.

get.summary: The journey, with one next action in front
get.description: UC-9 and UC-12. While paused, returns a calm check-in and no task list.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the case does not exist.

post.summary: Step back from tasks for a while
post.description: UC-12. Holds all progress exactly as it is. Stores only the time the pause ends. No reason or feeling is collected or stored.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the case does not exist.

post.description: UC-12. Returns the journey with the same single next action as before the pause.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the case does not exist.

get.summary: Everything done, in progress, and next, in one view
get.description: UC-13. Grouped by certificates, agencies, financial institutions, and other areas.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the case does not exist.

get.summary: Open a task with its guidance and sources
get.description: Guidance, citations to the issuing authority, and anything already recorded for it.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the task does not exist.

patch.summary: Change a task's status or snooze it
patch.description: Setting status to done records the completion time. The response carries the next action.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the task does not exist.

post.description: UC-10. Saves copies and expected arrival, marks the task done, and returns the next task.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the task does not exist.

409.description: This task is not the death certificate task.

post.summary: Record that an institution was notified
post.description: UC-11. Records the institution as notified and, by default, marks the task done so the journey moves on. Sending the same institution name again updates that entry.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the task does not exist.

409.description: This task is not an institution notification task.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true. Sent only after the user confirms.

voice.description: The voice chosen in onboarding or Settings. Tone only.

status.description: Effective status. read_only once the trial has ended.

trial_end_date.title: Trial End Date
trial_end_date.description: trial_ends_at as a date in the account's time zone.

ai_label.title: Ai Label
ai_label.description: Show in every chat view once set.

AccountPatch.title: AccountPatch
AccountPatch.description: Settings. The voice can be changed at any time. Omitted fields are unchanged.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: The read-only banner or a due trial reminder, when there is one.

client.title: Client
client.description: App platform and version, stored on the consent record.

AcknowledgmentIn.title: AcknowledgmentIn
AcknowledgmentIn.description: agreed=false is the "I'm not sure" path (UC-REG-10). Nothing is recorded for it.

document_version.title: Document Version
document_version.description: Send back when agreeing, to show which text was agreed to.

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: How Cairn would reply in this voice.

start_journey.title: Start Journey
start_journey.description: Generate the journey in the same request if the minimum fields are present.

CreateCaseRequest.title: CreateCaseRequest
CreateCaseRequest.description:
Creates the case, the first owner membership, and the deceased record in one transaction.

death_event and estate_flags are optional so a fiduciary with complete
records can send everything in one session (UC-8). Each section is still
validated and audited on its own.

death_state.title: Death State
death_state.description: State where the death occurred. This decides which vital records office issues the certificate. It may differ from the state of residence.

DeceasedIdentityPatch.title: DeceasedIdentityPatch
DeceasedIdentityPatch.description: Edits after the first save. Omitted fields are left unchanged. Null clears an optional field.

EstateFlagsIn.title: EstateFlagsIn
EstateFlagsIn.description: Answer one question at a time. Omitted fields are unchanged. 'skip' saves 'unknown'.

complete_task.title: Complete Task
complete_task.description: Mark the task done after recording this notice.

InstitutionNoticeRequest.title: InstitutionNoticeRequest
InstitutionNoticeRequest.description: Record that an institution was told. Do not send account numbers. There is no field for them.

ready_for_journey.title: Ready For Journey
ready_for_journey.description: True when the minimum fields for the journey are present.

action.title: Action
action.description: Machine-readable step code the client routes on.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Plain-language text to show the user.

NextStep.title: NextStep
NextStep.description: The single next thing to ask or do. Clients render one question at a time.

PauseRequest.title: PauseRequest
PauseRequest.description: No reason field, on purpose. Cairn does not store why someone stepped back.

name_from_provider.title: Name From Provider
name_from_provider.description: A name Google or Apple shared at sign-in. Kept only to pre-fill the preferred name question. Apple sends it on the first sign-in only, so send it then.

time_zone.title: Time Zone
time_zone.description: Used to show trial dates in local time.

ai_provider.title: Ai Provider
ai_provider.description: Third-party AI provider, named before any data is sent to it.

Screen.title: Screen
Screen.description: What to render. One question per screen. The question itself is next_step.prompt.

auth0_connection.title: Auth0 Connection
auth0_connection.description: Pass as the connection parameter to Auth0's /authorize to skip the chooser and go straight to this method.

content_reviewed_by_counsel.title: Content Reviewed By Counsel
content_reviewed_by_counsel.description: False while the guidance is an unreviewed draft. Clients should label it as such.

TaskKind.title: TaskKind
TaskKind.description: Tasks with a structured completion record. Everything else is 'general'.

prefill.title: Prefill
prefill.description: Shared by Google or Apple. Show it for the user to confirm or change. Never save it without that.

TriStateAnswer.title: TriStateAnswer
TriStateAnswer.description: What the client may send. 'skip' is stored as 'unknown'.

Voice.title: Voice
Voice.description: How Cairn talks with the user (UC-REG-12). Tone only. Defined in voices/manifest.yaml.

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: A voice from the personality screen. choose_for_me selects the default voice, steady_direct.

methods.title: Methods
methods.description: Equally weighted. Show all three with the same emphasis.

HTTPBearer.description: Auth0 access token for the Cairn API audience.
